svg.title: Green Black
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Phillips explicitly states a single canvas with two painted color fields. Six-sided outline and angled green lower-right quadrilateral were inspected; wall outside outline transparent.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.phillips.com/detail/ellsworth-kelly/73998; record phillips-73998; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
